model_snapshot: 31 October 2026; allocations preserved; model statuses unchanged

parent.text: The CarCareLog System shall process each accepted vehicle-service request according to its requested maintenance-information operation.

requirements.text: The Application Service shall interface with the Web Interface through the Web Interface / Application Service.
The Application Service shall interface with the Vehicle Record Store through the Application Service / Vehicle Record Store.
The Application Service shall Calculate Maintenance Summary and Reminders.
The Application Service shall Coordinate Confirmed Record Transactions.
The Application Service shall Coordinate AI Requests and Responses.
The Application Service shall Validate and Route Owner Requests.
The Application Service shall provide Prepared vehicle information to the Web Interface.
The Application Service shall provide Authorized vehicle record query to the Vehicle Record Store.
The Application Service shall provide Confirmed service record to the Vehicle Record Store.
The Application Service shall provide Service status and incident report to the Application Operator.
The Application Service shall provide Vehicle question and authorized evidence context to the AI Model Runtime.
The Application Service shall provide Receipt extraction request to the AI Model Runtime.
The Application Service shall accept Authorized records and source references from the Vehicle Record Store.
The Application Service shall accept Validated owner service request from the Web Interface.
The Application Service shall accept Evidence-backed answer or AI failure response from the AI Model Runtime.
The Application Service shall accept Proposed date, mileage, items, cost, and provider from the AI Model Runtime.
The Application Service shall accept Configuration and maintenance instructions from the Application Operator.
The Application Service shall accept Referenced maintenance interval rules from the Vehicle Owner.
The Application Service shall accept Configured AI service contract limits from the Application Operator.
The Application Service shall accept Owner authorization and confirmation policy from the Application Operator.
The Application Service shall accept Stored record confirmation from the Vehicle Record Store.
The Application Service shall restrict protected vehicle data used in application processing and AI evidence context to the selected vehicle’s authorized owner.

scope: Local manual-record alternative. Owner authentication and production AI are not implemented. Passing a component case does not close its full requirement.

supplements.text: The Application Service shall exchange the messages defined in IC-03 with the AI Model Runtime using the field, direction, unit and error definitions in that contract.
The Application Service shall rebuild its record-dependent summaries from the restored confirmed records supplied by the Vehicle Record Store after a storage recovery.
The Application Service shall restrict protected vehicle data used in application processing and AI evidence context to the selected vehicle's authorized owner.
The Maintenance Summary Component shall calculate maintenance summaries and reminders from authorized confirmed records and referenced interval rules.
The Application Service shall allow authorized core record read and manual confirmed-record submission when the AI Model Runtime is unavailable.
The Application Service shall retain repeatable regression evidence for its routing, AI coordination, confirmed transactions and maintenance calculations before release.
The Application Service shall provide the proposal, receipt reference, validation outcome and confirmation status needed for the owner to review and confirm a receipt-assisted record.
The Record Transaction Component shall send a maintenance record to the Vehicle Record Store only when the selected vehicle is authorized and the owner has explicitly confirmed the record.
The Application Service shall exchange the messages defined in IC-01 with the Web Interface using the field, direction, unit and error definitions in that contract.
The Application Service shall exchange the messages defined in IC-04 with the Application Operator using the field, direction, unit and error definitions in that contract.
The Application Service shall exchange the messages defined in IC-02 with the Vehicle Record Store using the field, direction, unit and error definitions in that contract.
The AI Coordination Component shall return a receipt proposal, supported answer, insufficient-evidence result or explicit failure for each authorized AI operation.
The Request Routing Component shall route each authorized owner service request to the processing path specified by its operation.

stakeholder_SR08.text: CarCareLog shall display the upcoming or overdue status of each configured maintenance item for the selected vehicle.
stakeholder_SR08.parameter: 30 days or 500 miles (804.672 km), retained earlier document baseline; native requirement unchanged
